page_summary:
This is the second half (pages 6 through 10) of the same ten-page sequence from Folder 18 of Philip K. Dick's Exegesis continued from the preceding pages 1-5, dated August 1978. No OCR text layer exists for these pages in this corpus, so their specific content cannot be reported. Together with the first five pages, this completes a full ten-page segment from a single folder dating to a particularly intense period of Exegesis composition, as Dick was developing the theological and cosmological framework that would go on to inform the VALIS trilogy.

**Why it matters.** As the second half of an unpublished, untranscribed folder from Dick's mid-period Exegesis, this document would be of considerable scholarly value if and when its content becomes accessible, offering a data point for the theological and cosmological development that fed into the VALIS trilogy beyond what survives in the published, edited Exegesis (2011).
